name: Tampa (United States)
description: A field quartered by a white cross bearing red-and-blue stripes, the quarters in red, blue, green and white patterns, with the city seal at the centre — one of the busiest of American civic flags.
history: Designed by fireman Albert Barnes and adopted in 1930; its riot of stripes and quarters makes it one of the most distinctive (and most criticized) US city flags.

features.role: quartered field with striped cross overlay
